findings.title: Final authenticated read can outlive account context validation
findings.scenario: Second context guard succeeds, then last awaited storage read/decryption is suspended while account locks or changes. No subsequent guard runs and recovery broadcasts. Same recoverSaved path affects recover and reconcilePrevious.
